name: print-social-night-city-tower-cover-with-giant-white-caps
title: Night photo of a lit residential tower with giant white caps and small blue labels
whatItIs: A dark night cityscape with a tall striped tower with a glowing crown and a bridge of orange lights, a small blue 'СОЮЗ' at the top left, giant white 'ЗАСТРОЙЩИКОВ' across the top and a small blue name at the right.
whatItMeans: Bold and civic; the night lights give dignity to a developer association.
techniques: Place giant caps across the dark sky.
Use small blue labels as secondary text.
Let a glowing tower be the hero.
Keep the palette to night blues and warm lights.

vocabulary.definition: A large headline set in dark sky.
A prominent building as the subject.
